import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000100;
    static int[] snm = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] sz = new int[MAXN];
    static final long mod = 1000000007L;

    static int getroot(int u) {
        if (snm[u] == u) {
            return u;
        } else {
            snm[u] = getroot(snm[u]);
            return snm[u];
        }
    }

    static void merge(int u, int v) {
        u = getroot(u);
        v = getroot(v);
        if (u != v) {
            sz[u] += sz[v];
            snm[v] = u;
        }
    }

    static long isok(long a, long b, long p) {
        long res = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * a) % p;
            }
            a = (a * a) % p;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return (res == 1) ? p : 1;
    }

    static long binpow(long a, long b) {
        long res = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * a) % mod;
            }
            a = (a * a) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(binpow(p, p - 1));
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            snm[i] = i;
            sz[i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            merge((int)((k * 1L * i) % p), i);
        }

        long ans = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (getroot(i) == i) {
                ans = (ans * isok(k, sz[i], p)) % mod;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
